extracted.intended_audience: patrons and performing comedians at Laugh Factory Chicago (audience members, visiting comics, open-mic participants)
extracted.subtask_description: Venue-level rules, show formats, and performer/attendee procedures for Laugh Factory Chicago: age/payment/seating policies, open-mic sign-up and selection, and format-specific descriptions (Fresh Faces, Brew Comedy, The Nasty Show, Sashay, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Age restriction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed on nearly every show listing; applies to patrons attending shows unless otherwise stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum
rubrics_metrics.description: 2 drink minimum per person (can be non-alcoholic or alcoholic beverage)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated across most shows; applies per patron. Some shows (Open Mic) explicitly say 'No drink minimum'.

rubrics_metrics.name: General admission / seating policy
rubrics_metrics.description: General Admission is based on first come first serve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seating is first come, first served; ticket holders may be subject to standing room. Doors often open 60 minutes prior to show (see 'Doors open 60min prior to start of show').

rubrics_metrics.name: 18% service fee on drink tabs
rubrics_metrics.description: 18% service fee will be applied to all drink tabs at payment to be given directly to service staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied at payment and distributed to service staff; mentioned on many show pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: No cash / cash-payment policy (showroom/door)
rubrics_metrics.description: NO CASH PAYMENTS ACCEPTED. / NO CASH in the showroom! Please bring a credit/debit card for purchasing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several listings state 'NO CASH PAYMENTS ACCEPTED' or 'NO CASH in the showroom'. However, specific shows (e.g., Sashay) note you can exchange cash/Venmo for dollar bills to tip performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted payment methods (footer)
rubrics_metrics.description: WE ACCEPT: CASH, CARDS , APPLE PAY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footer/contact area lists accepted payment options for the venue generally; may conflict with per-show 'no cash' notices (venue-level vs. showroom-level differences).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vouchers not redeemable at the door
rubrics_metrics.description: Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated note on many show listings; instructs voucher-holders not to expect redemption on arrival.

rubrics_metrics.name: No refunds policy (select shows)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly stated in event descriptions (e.g., Early Bird Comedy Special); indicates ticket purchases may be final for certain shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Doors open time
rubrics_metrics.description: Doors open 60min prior to start of show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to set arrival expectations and relates to first-come seating policies; listed for several shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic sign-up & selection rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign-ups are at 7pm at the Laugh Factory to perform at the 9pm show. Random draw for comics and every night a comic will be selected to perform on a future showcase! No drink minimum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open Mic participants must sign up in person at the specified time; selection via random draw; outstanding performers can be invited to future showcases.

rubrics_metrics.name: No drink minimum for Open Mic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception to the general two-drink minimum policy applies to Open Mic shows as stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fresh Faces show format / selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Fresh Faces of Chicago presents 5 comics who are new to the Laugh Factory Chicago stage as well as ones that you can't get enough of - they are our 'Fresh Faces'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format emphasizes up-and-coming talent; typically happens the last Tuesday of the month; designed for discovery/exposure of new local comics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brew Comedy purpose (new material testing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Brew Comedy is where new jokes are poured fresh. This show gives comedians a space to test-drive brand-new material--ideas that are still fermenting, freshly brewed, or just a little unfiltered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience expectations: some bits will become classics, some may 'spill'; show is specifically for testing and developing new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Nasty Show content warning / format
rubrics_metrics.description: This ain't your grandma's stand up... in-your-face, no-holds-barred comedy! It may get dark. It may get dirty. It may make you question what's appropriate to laugh at in public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit/adult-oriented content warning; intended audience is adults (18+); prepares patrons for edgier material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service Industry Night complimentary entry rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Our 'Service Industry Night' welcomes bartenders, servers, and bar and restaurant workers -- along with their family, friends, and everyone else! Bring in your restaurant check-stub or event invitation for complimentary entry!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event-specific admission policy granting complimentary entry on presentation of a check-stub or invitation; targets service-industry workers.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Date Comedy Gameshow format rules
rubrics_metrics.description: One audience member is selected and brought on stage but visually separated from the comedians. They can hear the jokes but won't be able to see the faces telling them. After hearing all the sets, they'll decide which comic won them over; a first date happens live on stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes show mechanics and audience participation/selection process; sets expectations for participants and attendees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sashay show format & tipping mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Sashay brings together queer comedians and drag artists for a brunch show. You will be able to exchange cash and Venmo for dollar bills to tip the performers before and during the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format-specific rules: brunch-time, drag/queer-focused, tips facilitated by on-site cash/Venmo exchange despite general 'no cash' showroom notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rocket Force / Something Unexpected / headliner show descriptions (booking expectations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows like Rocket Force Comedy and Something Unexpected feature rising stars and nationally touring 'killers' or comics from Comedy Central, HBO and Conan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These descriptions set expectations about performer caliber and booking—i.e., these showcases are for higher-profile or rising national talent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking / valet information
rubrics_metrics.description: VALET SERVICE IN FRONT OF THE CLUB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venue provides valet service; useful operational info for attendees arriving by car.
